scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'')){console.error('Use pnpm instead of npm/yarn. Enable: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.32.1 --activate');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
